source.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: PPO-style RLHF follows another route. A policy generates fresh responses, a learned reward model scores them, and the optimizer updates the policy from those rollouts while controlling reference drift.
teaching.moment: Compare the fixed-pair DPO update with fresh rollout generation and reward scoring in PPO-style RLHF.
teaching.scope: The overview does not prove converged policies or outcomes are identical and does not remove the reference-scoring contract.
teaching.caption: Compare fixed preference-pair training with rollout generation and reward-based updates.
